commentary_segments.text: The other source of white noise is the shot noise, generated by a junction, or diode. This is white noise but not thermal noise. Indeed this noise current is proportional to the current but is independent of the temperature. Cooling therefore, does not help! This applies to any junction (or diode) which carries current. It is irrelevant whether the current flows in the forward direction (as in any forward biased diode) or in the reverse direction (as in a photodiode). The same expression is still valid.
